input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only liability cap in the agreement (buried at the end of Section 12, Indemnity) is one-sided: it limits TrueLink's liability alone, leaving Client's liability — including its very broad indemnity under Section 12a — entirely uncapped, which is our walk-away position. The cap basis is also narrow ("total compensation paid" for Hosting and Support Services only, excluding other agreed services under Section 5a and amounts payable but unpaid), and there is no mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and no carve-out set beyond TrueLink's gross negligence/wilful misconduct. The redline makes the cap mutual at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, adds the mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and places indemnification, confidentiality/data protection and security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap, with Client's payment obligations not treated as capped damages.

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap mutual, set it at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, and place indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the limitation of liability mutual and meaningful — the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000 — rather than a one-way cap that protects only TrueLink while leaving Client's liability unlimited, and we added a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages. Consistent with our playbook, indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and Client's obligation to pay fees is not capped; if helpful we can fall back to a straight twelve months' fees cap with these carve-outs retained.

ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY CLIENT UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) USD 1,000,000, AND NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 12, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS; CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THE FOREGOING CAP.
